description: Turn a grayscale ink coverage grid into an angled one-bit screen with round dots. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.03 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. Up to 256 × 256 pixels. Returns binary rows with 1 for ink.
